title: Leptogenesis
description: Matter and antimatter should have annihilated perfectly. They did not: heavy neutrinos decayed out of equilibrium, unequally to leptons and antileptons, and sphalerons turned the excess into baryons - one in a billion. Unlocks the Baryon Asymmetry Crystal.

puzzle.goal: How rare are baryons? Count the photons: a black-body gas at temperature T has, per unit volume, an integral over energy of E² times the Bose-Einstein occupation 1/(e^{E/k_BT} − 1), times the density of states for two polarisations, 1/π² (units ħ = c = 1). Write the number density of photons.
puzzle.name: Photon number density of black-body radiation (the baryon-to-photon ratio)
puzzle.ask: The integral gives n_γ = 2ζ(3)(k_BT)³/π² ≈ 20.29·T³ photons per cm³ (T in kelvin). Today T = @{T} K. With n × 10⁻⁷ baryons per cm³, find the baryon-to-photon ratio η = n_B/n_γ in units of 10⁻¹⁰.
puzzle.method: Integrate the occupation number over momentum space: d³p/(2π)³ times two polarisations is E²dE/π². The integral of x²/(eˣ − 1) is 2ζ(3).
